blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-migration-1 (rename_all = "camelCase" renames every existing field of the public order JSON) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-migration-2 (Existing config.toml files without default_currency stop loading) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Remove `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]`: it turns `order_id`, `customer_id` and `total_cents` into `orderId`, `customerId` and `totalCents`, so every partner integration reading `GET /orders/{id}` today gets missing fields on the first response after the upgrade. docs/api.md still lists the snake_case names and promises "a field is never renamed or removed without two releases of deprecation"; the proposal's release note only says "Added", with no BREAKING item. Keep the snake_case names (the new field is then `currency`), and add a serialization test pinning the JSON keys. If camelCase is ever wanted, follow the documented two-release deprecation and mark it BREAKING in the release note.
findings.title: rename_all = "camelCase" renames every existing field of the public order JSON

findings.evidence:
/// The currency of orders that do not name one (ISO 4217).
pub default_currency: String,
findings.recommendation: `default_currency` is required with no `#[serde(default)]`, so every deployed `config.toml` written before this change (holding only `database_url` and `listen`) fails in `toml::from_str` with a "missing field `default_currency`" error and the service does not start after the upgrade. Nothing in the release note tells operators to add the key. Give the field a default (e.g. `#[serde(default = "default_currency")]` returning "EUR", the currency the shop sold in before), add a test loading the old two-key config, or else mark the new required key BREAKING in the release note with the manual step.
findings.title: Existing config.toml files without default_currency stop loading
